$comment: Color-blind-safe palette library. `colorblind_safe: true` means the palette passes the Okabe-Ito / ColorBrewer CVD guidance used by check-colorblind.

palettes.name: Okabe-Ito
palettes.notes: The default CVD-safe categorical palette (Okabe & Ito 2008).

palettes.name: ColorBrewer Dark2
palettes.notes: 8-class qualitative, recommended when >6 Okabe-Ito categories are needed.

palettes.name: ColorBrewer Set2
palettes.notes: Pastel qualitative scheme; pair with strong symbol/line encoding for print.

palettes.name: ColorBrewer Set1
palettes.notes: NOT fully CVD safe (red/green pair). Swap via check-colorblind when needed.

palettes.name: viridis (12-step)
palettes.notes: Perceptually uniform sequential map, CVD-safe luminance ramp.

palettes.name: CVD-safe diverging (blue - light - orange)
palettes.notes: ColorBrewer RdBu-style diverging without a red/green axis.
